purpose: First-pass CPO tariff evidence for previously unvisited Germany identities. No tariff is generalized beyond its evidenced payment surface.

cpos.operatorEvidence: Official Stadtwerke Kiel public-charging page confirms its charging infrastructure and a contract-free Ad-hoc / Direct Payment path via QR code or NFC into the chargecloud payment surface with credit card settlement.
cpos.tariffEvidence: The official public page does not expose a numeric 2026 direct-payment tariff. No subscriber/app value was substituted and no chargecloud tariff was inferred without an EVSE-specific checkout payload.
cpos.neededToComplete: A current EVSE-level chargecloud Direct Payment checkout payload or an official Stadtwerke Kiel ad-hoc price matrix linking prices to the operator's EVSEs.

cpos.operatorEvidence: Official operator page states that more than 100 public points in Jena and surroundings are operated by Stadtwerke Energie and identifies operator charge-point identifiers beginning DEJEN or DEJOB.
cpos.tariffEvidence: Official prices from 2026-01-01 are 0.49 EUR/kWh AC and 0.59 EUR/kWh DC plus a 3 EUR/month card base fee and blocking fee rules; the page explicitly presents these as Stadtwerke Energie charging-card prices. They are therefore not promoted as contract-free ad-hoc pricing.
cpos.neededToComplete: An official direct-payment/ad-hoc price surface or EVSE checkout for DEJEN/DEJOB points, distinct from the monthly charging-card contract.

cpos.operatorEvidence: Official current page states that Stadtwerke Flensburg operates 48 charging points and that third-party roaming cards also work on the network. A separate official business solution documents Direct Pay by PayPal or credit card, but does not prove that identical Direct Pay is enabled or identically priced on every public SWFL EVSE.
cpos.tariffEvidence: Official Flensburg Ladekarte tariff valid from 2026-02-01 is 0.39 EUR/kWh AC, 0.49 EUR/kWh DC and 0.10 EUR/min blocking fee after 240 minutes capped at 12 EUR, with a one-time 9.50 EUR card/chip provisioning fee. Because this is a contractual RFID product and the public-network FAQ says other providers' tariffs depend on the provider, it is not substituted as ad-hoc/direct pricing.
cpos.neededToComplete: A public-SWFL-EVSE Direct Pay checkout/QR payload or an official ad-hoc price sheet for the public network; the hotel/gastronomy Direct Pay product alone is insufficient to generalize.

guardrails: No subscriber, Ladekarte or roaming tariff generalized to ad-hoc.
No third-party sampled price generalized network-wide.
No eMI3 prefix invented; DEJEN/DEJOB retained only as operator-published charge-point identifier prefixes for Jena.
Previously deferred CPOs were not re-audited.
